nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What are two insights generated from this study regarding the use of REEs?
nodes.answer: The study provides insights on using phytoextracted biomass containing REEs as valuable REEs/C materials and how to utilize technology to promote recycling of used materials to save the environment.

nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What percentage of companies in the survey indicated they reuse or recycle materials with high frequency?
nodes.answer: Approximately 61% of the companies who provided feedback and 52% of the total sample reported reusing and recycling materials with high frequency, despite not being fully convinced about the diffusion of this practice.
